meta.scope: Correct S025 modelling method from predictive coding to LASSO-PCR and bound TENS interpretation

records.title: A predictive corticospinal model for pain perception

decisions.notes: The study applies CsPIP to independent experimental and one IBS chronic-pain cohort, but TENS sensitivity is assessed in a subset of the discovery study whose baseline data contributed to model development. The treated-side TENS association is r=0.36, p=0.049, not an independent TENS validation. No ECAP, SCS response or clinical treatment-efficacy inference follows.
